## Purpose
The credentials a hand-picked set of tools will read, and whether each reaches them. It is for forms that attach tools directly (Create agent in the builder, an agent's equipped tools), where no build runs the prerequisite check. A missing credential can be added to the vault in place.

## Responsibilities
- `ToolCredentialsCheck({tools})` uses `VaultSecretDialog`.

## Key elements
`ToolCredentialsCheck`.
